[[Customizations]]
listName = 'test-list'
removeData = [
  '<root>/mods/G',
]
removeContent = [
  'Curated Two.esp',
]

insert = '<root>/mods/C'
before = '<root>/game'

[[Customizations.insert]]
insert = 'Gamma.esp'
after = 'Curated Two.esp'

# Yours: carried through unchanged. This tool never writes a replace of
# its own -- only insert, append and remove blocks are regenerated.
# mlox sorts Late Patch.esp to position 4 of 6
#   after: Curated One.esp
# A replace has no after/before -- it inherits the position of source --
# so if that is not where it sits now, only you can move it: change this
# block to an insert, or leave it as it is on purpose.
[[Customizations.replace]]
source = 'Curated One.esp'
dest = 'Late Patch.esp'
